error.provider_unavailable: OpenCode Go is not available. Set DSH_OPENCODE_GO_KEY. This engine does not fall back to GPT.
error.unsafe_codex_home: Refusing to use the original ~/.codex directory. Choose a separate data directory.
error.binary_required: A Codex CLI binary path is required. This package does not bundle the CLI.
error.home_mismatch: App Server reported a CODEX_HOME that is not this engine's isolated directory.
error.session_not_found: No Codex thread is bound to this session.
error.session_exists: This session is already bound to a Codex thread.
error.turn_in_flight: This session already has a turn in progress.
error.no_active_turn: This session has no active turn.
error.persist_failed: Could not save the session mapping.
error.provider_rerouted: The provider changed models. Further turns are blocked so this does not become a silent GPT fallback.
error.provider_mismatch: App Server returned a different provider. The mapping was not saved.
error.model_mismatch: App Server returned a different model. The mapping was not saved.
error.rpc_failed: The Codex App Server request failed.
error.spawn_failed: Could not start the Codex App Server process.
error.timeout: The Codex App Server request timed out.
error.protocol: The Codex App Server sent a protocol message this engine could not accept.
error.line_too_long: The Codex App Server sent a message larger than the size limit. The session is preserved.
error.invalid_history_page: History page options are invalid. Use a page size from 1 to 50 and an opaque string cursor.
error.history_cursor_stale: The history page changed. Reload the chat to continue.
error.invalid_cwd: Working directory must be an absolute path.
error.process_exit: The Codex App Server process exited.
error.aborted: The Codex App Server request was cancelled.
error.not_ready: The Codex App Server is not ready.
error.approval_not_found: That approval request is no longer waiting.
status.limitations: Engine foundation only. No DSH agent factory, transcript adapter, or Codex UI. Voice, browser, and remote control are not implemented.
error.profile_model_mismatch: This chat uses a model-specific instruction profile. Create a new chat to use a different model.
error.turn_state_unknown: The previous request has not been confirmed. Check its native turn before sending another request.
